items: Five faces the moodboard never got
The pages that are still a paragraph
Who is glad to see them and who is not
A downtime board, not just a training tracker

Worldbuilding and Plans ingestion: still open

NEXT MILESTONE UNNAMED. Both v0.5 deliverables shipped (campaigns entities on 2026-08-03/04, the proficiency training tracker recorded in CHANGELOG.md), so v0.5 is closed and nothing has been declared after it. Naming what comes next is Kane’s, and the number below cannot move honestly until something does.

Basis for the 55 percent hold: the figure is NOT re-derived here. It was anchored 2026-07-06 and the two deliverables that closed since were already counted toward it when it was set. Re-anchoring the date without moving the number records that the staleness was looked at on 2026-08-24 and that the number was left deliberately, rather than leaving a date that implies nobody has checked in seven weeks (bar-raise observability-02 / strategic-kill-this-01).

actions.title: Refuse the dismissal, hook-pin and world-claim writes when the preceding read failed, instead of overwriting the store.
Drop today's questions minted past the ceiling from the vault, then confirm the build exits zero before running the release again; never raise the cap to get past this.
Extract the page renderers out of web/build.mjs into their own module, leaving orchestration and the gate calls behind.
Refuse the write and return an error when the preceding read threw, instead of writing the fallback default.
Log the caught error in the three throttle functions and keep the fail-open behaviour.
REDACTED: a MED severity finding in the security lens is withheld from the public copy. See this project's own bar-raise report for detail.
Precompute a faction, region and tag membership index once before the render loop and look candidates up in it.
Replace the sequential per-key reads with a batched read matching the answer loader.
Fail the build on a duplicate shop slug and give it a page-checks row, the same as the other named gates.
Raise the inventory-mirror write failure and the stale-revision skip to error level.
Split the table password from the gate password by setting it as its own high-entropy secret.
Batch those two reads the way every sibling loader already does.
Give the session token a server-checked identifier so signing out can revoke it.
Write the three missing jobs, or stop naming those channels as live topics.
Add a live post-deploy check that the catalog asset answers unauthorized to an anonymous caller, following the shape already used for the gate.
Have a session read what the interrupted pass was doing, then either finish committing it with an explicit path list or revert it cleanly, and never let a second pass build on top of it unexamined.
Identify the questions past the three-a-day cap and drop them from the vault files, verifying the cap gate clears afterward; do not raise the cap to get past it.
Give the gate family a fixture-driven test file following the shape of the two existing gate tests.
Lift the gate family into a checks module in the same change that adds its test file.
Coalesce the global recency key and wrap its write, so one shared key stops being touched on every transaction.
Record the second vendored graphics file's revision beside the existing entry.
Add an abort-signal timeout to the ten remaining network calls that carry none.
Adopt a version marker on new or changing keyspaces going forward.
Surface the two known silent-drop conditions in the portrait prompt tooling.
Record a retention rule for the questionnaire files, or reduce respondents to initials.
Measure one shop rotation and one multi-tick day advance at the current shop count.
Mint a separate high-entropy machine secret alongside the human passphrase.

closedLog.evidence: all three stores (the dismissal map, the hook-pin map, web/world-claims.mjs) return a server error and skip the write when their own read threw, so one transient failure no longer discards every other entry; shipped v0.3.632
the release path is unblocked: two releases ran end to end on 2026-09-22, v0.3.632 and v0.3.633
web/renderers.mjs takes all six per-entity renderers; build.mjs fell from 11,147 lines to 10,888 and the ratchet came down with it; shipped v0.3.632
the same fix, seen on two of the three stores; shipped v0.3.632
the four silent catch blocks in the passphrase throttle and the new write throttle each log what failed and what it cost, keeping the fail-open behaviour; shipped v0.3.632
the five endpoints a reader can reach share a per-caller rolling window, forty posts in five minutes, failing open on a storage error; web/gate-auth.mjs, shipped v0.3.632
relatedFor reads an index built once rather than walking the whole entity array per page; two full builds compared file by file differ only in the build stamp; shipped v0.3.632
both list endpoints batch with Promise.all; shipped v0.3.632
a duplicate shop slug fails the build as SHOP-DUP, with PAGE_CHECKS row ORG-15; shipped v0.3.632
the trade-apply inventory divergence logs at error level; shipped v0.3.632
both list endpoints batch; shipped v0.3.632
the session token carries a per-login identifier stored as sess:<sid>, checked on read and deleted on sign-out, so one session can be revoked; shipped v0.3.632
the annex names the two channels with a job and records the other three as created-but-unposted, with what a post to them would need first; shipped v0.3.632
the catalog rules-text asset has its own live post-deploy check, which passed on both releases of 2026-09-22
the 327-path stranded pass is gone: the tree is clean, HEAD is origin/main, and the orphan commit's file was superseded by the sweep's own later state, read and compared
the question cap passes; the build exits zero and two releases ran from it on 2026-09-22
tests/build-gates.test.mjs, twenty-six cases over all five gate predicates, in a tenth of a second; shipped v0.3.632
web/build-gates.mjs holds the predicates; byte-identical site output; shipped v0.3.632
the global shop recency key coalesces, so a shop touched repeatedly inside a minute writes the index once, and the write no longer voids a completed sale; shipped v0.3.632
PROJECT_SPEC.md documents OrbitControls.js as the matching pinned r128 file with its source, licence and lockstep requirement; shipped v0.3.630
ten unattended network calls in the routines carry an abort-signal timeout, matching the two that already did; shipped v0.3.632
the keyspace registry records the versioning rule: a shape change mints a new prefix and never repurposes an old one, which is the seam the shop migration already used; shipped v0.3.632

both silent-drop conditions print under every brief tools/charart/brief.py writes, and the age-plus-female collision is named on the thirty-two pages that trip it; CHECKS.md section 16 is the single owner and REDRAW.md points at it; shipped v0.3.632
the retention rule is written into the file it governs and into PROJECT_SPEC.md section 6, with the reason the first names stay; shipped v0.3.632

measured: the capped eight-tick day advance takes 39 to 44 ms of processor time over 332 shops against an unbound budget of 50, and gate 10 in verify.ps1 holds it there on every commit; shipped v0.3.632
ruled and recorded in PROJECT_SPEC.md section 6, with the three conditions that reopen it; shipped v0.3.632
the release notification's web request carries a ten-second timeout, the one call in the release path that had no bound; commit 174f90f1
tools/statblocks/render.py and tools/route/build_route.py write through a read-back verify helper, replacing five direct writes with no truncation check on this mount; commit 174f90f1

the public-only warning in tools/ingest-answers/collect.mjs prints immediately before the final summary as well as early, which is where the routine's own documentation points a reader; commit 174f90f1

unactionable as written: every tool that calls a gated endpoint (forge-drain, continuity, kv-snapshot, the two ingest tools, answer-check) reads the password file directly and sends it as a header on every call; none has an interactive prompt or a reusable session to fall back from, so there is no code the finding describes. A review re-raises it with a named file if a prompt is ever added.

the shared frontmatter parser is mid-flight in the live session that owns web/frontmatter.mjs and tools/world/; build.mjs already imports from it, tools/lore-audit/audit.mjs does not yet, and the remainder is queue row gnosis-build-mjs-session-2026-09-02

the exact change is recorded (three re-derivations of the public entity list at build.mjs 5687, 8604, 8896 become the pub array already defined at line 244); it needs the session that holds build.mjs, which is queue row gnosis-build-mjs-session-2026-09-02

forge-drain.mjs writes through the same write-then-verify guard build.mjs uses, tested standalone; commit 174f90f1. The shop economy half is decided (one combined record per shop, PROJECT_SPEC.md section 6) and its cutover is queue row gnosis-shop-economy-kv-migration-2026-09-02.

already fixed. web/build.mjs replaces the full body text with a title citation for every item from the four unlicensed corpora, landed in commit 0b3d6787 earlier today under an unrelated message. Verified against the generated public output rather than the source: a pass over web/dist/assets/items-desc.json finds 1195 items from those sources, all 1195 carrying the citation block, none leaking raw
every passphrase comparison in the worker now goes through the failed-guess throttle, not only the sign-in route. Commit 6f6896d0, deployed in release v0.3.517.
the moodboard-backfill backlog row no longer names an image-generation tool on the public page. Commit 435d42c4, deployed in release v0.3.517.

the build script stops hardcoding the em dash and the PAGE-09 check now watches the rendered site for one, so the check reaches the output rather than the source alone. Commit ce656e29, deployed in release v0.3.517.
